title: The Battle of the Bulge: Marian returns through paratroopers
summary: Civilians are evacuated; Marian returns through paratroopers to take musicians for a Christmas show.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: get married in Belgium because I didn't have any divorce papers. So the only way we could get married was in Germany.. And so the chaplain was getting things set up but everybody tried to talk her out of it and talk me out of it. But no, no, no. And then the Bulge came along. The Battle of the Bulge, they bombed the town and strafed us and then they dropped paratroopers around.

Well Marian had to get out. They sent all civiliens out of town. We had to stay in town to fight. And then they bombed us and strafed us and And they dropped paratroopers around the town. When Marian came back a couple of days later, through a bunch of paratroopers.
Well, she just got a weapons carrier and got somebody to drive her and they came right through. And they came to Major Adamsand said please we need you and Jimmy and few of the other

people for a show to come back to Herve with us, we're going to put on a Christmas show. And we all trundled in the weapons carrier and it took us right back to Herve, down in Belgium a little way and put on a Christmas show.
